limitations: This board is for directional comparison only; no option is approved and no exact typeface is selected.
All options use live text and locally available generic or system stacks, so glyphs, metrics, kerning, spacing, and line placement may vary across environments.
No font file is committed, embedded, downloaded, vendored, or externally referenced.
The board contains no symbol and must not be treated as a lockup.
The options are not masters, candidates, exports, or runtime/public assets.
review_checklist: Choose a preferred option or reject all options.
Assess distinctiveness while accounting for environment-dependent substitution.
Assess conceptual fit next to the locked symbol without treating this board as a lockup.
Decide whether to proceed to exact font, provenance, and license selection.
Decide whether additional typographic directions are needed.
next_steps: Record the human decision to prefer one direction, request revisions, request new directions, or reject all.
If a direction proceeds, select an exact font and document its version, provenance, license, and permitted logo use in a separate approved task.
Only after exact font and license review may a real wordmark candidate or outlines be prepared under separate explicit approval.
